sentences.en: Yet as a blue-blooded politician from a hugely wealthy family, Hatoyama can hardly claim to represent a fresh alternative to Japan's political modus operandi.

sentences.en: But as a blue-blooded individual , let me just state that I am happier when a blue team wins.
